output.one_liner: Support platform for B2B teams built API-first with GraphQL, webhooks, and AI agents for handling customer conversations across multiple channels.

auth.notes: Bearer token authentication via API keys created for machine users. OAuth also available for user-delegated access.

evidence.snippet: Now that you have an API key, pass it on any API call as a header: Authorization: Bearer plainApiKey_xxx
Required headers: Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN where the token is your API key
To call the API as a user in your workspace, use an OAuth app

access.notes: 7-day free trial available to self-serve sign up. API credentials are created by workspace members via Settings. Continued use after trial requires paid plan starting at $45/user/month.

evidence.snippet: 7 day free trial · API Webhooks Events MCP Custom channels
Plain Pricing – Plans from $45/user/month | 7-Day Free Trial
Go to Settings → Machine users & agents and click Add machine user

api_surface.rate_limit_note: 450–1000 requests/minute depending on plan: Foundation 450, Horizon 600, Frontier 1000

evidence.snippet: API URL: https://core-api.uk.plain.com/graphql/v1 Allowed method: POST
Webhooks allow you to get notified about events happening in your Plain workspace
Plain applies rate limits to activity from machine users using the Plain API
The @team-plain/graphql package provides a fully typed client for Plain's GraphQL API
The Plain MCP server at https://mcp.plain.com/mcp lets tools like Claude work with support
An MCP server providing comprehensive access to the Plain.com API from Claude, with 77 tools

buildability.rationale: GraphQL API is well-documented, self-serve API key authentication is available, official MCP server exists, and Composio toolkit already exists with 120 tools.
